verdict.rationale: Creating a virtual display on the host is a fair capability to ask of a remote desktop tool, but nothing in the evidence pack documents RustDesk creating one or keeping rendering alive while headless or covered. Community reports of choosing between two physical screens describe adjacent multi-monitor selection, not virtual display creation. The driver-signing certificate discussion never says what the driver does, so it does not count either.

support.subject: As a power user, the host can create a virtual display, so a streamed window keeps rendering when covered or the machine runs headless
